data.name: Guard Target
data.description: Direct collective member to guard another member; directed member gains a +%1 competence bonus on attacks for %2 rounds.  Directed member may spend an attack of opportunity use to redirect attack on guarded member to himself.  You gain a cumulative +1 bonus to your next attack against the source of the redirected attack for each attack redirected.|GuardTargetBonus|GuardTargetDuration
